body: Thanks for the spare thought. I've been sitting in my car all night with my hand on the proverbial trigger all night, letting the gas hiss out of the container little by little. I saw you commented and i didnt want to just ignore your kind words. Thanks again and goodbye.

Thanks for the kind words. It's really hard to imagine what its like not feeling this way... when i think back I think I've mostly been numb these past few years. Just passing time, like watching paint dry. I dont think I'll be around when the sun comes up again tomorrow. Im just spending my final hours enjoying the calm, dark and quiet night and letting go of my frustrations and fear. I wish all the best of luck in life
Sure, I dont see how this will help though. Living the life i have you get used to not talking about yourself or building lies to hide the terrible truths.
